crossRefs.note: But Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for…
As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
Incline your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent…
“Hear, our God; for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land…
Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”
For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But…

translations.web: Give heed to me, Yahweh, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.
translations.bsb: Attend to me, O LORD. Hear what my accusers are saying!
translations.kjv: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend
translations.asv: Give heed to me, O Jehovah, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
